items.headline: Johnson and Glenn match wits once again as the Bears host the Jets in Week 4

items.headline: Are we seeing more NFL quarterback injuries than normal this season?
items.description: There have been eight QB injuries through three weeks of the NFL season, up a little bit from recent years. Is it a trend or just an outlier -- and is there a clear reason?

items.headline: Bears' Ben Johnson: 'Direction already made' on Week 4 QB call
items.description: Bears coach Ben Johnson said he knows the "direction" the team will go at quarterback in Week 4 but won't publicly declare a starter.
